School of Mathematical Sciences, Peking University · Beijing, China

Email ↗CV ↗Google Scholar ↗GitHub ↗

I am a Ph.D. student in Applied Mathematics at the School of Mathematical Sciences, Peking University, advised by Professor Lei Wu. I received my B.S. in Statistics from Peking University in June 2026.

My research interests include machine learning, deep learning theory, optimization theory and scaling laws, and large language model pretraining.
